spectralBoundary.reason: ASIV ordinal 39 passed integrated scalar and derived Level-B gates but did not establish a full-spectrum aerosol interpolation PASS; 26634 spectral nodes remained unresolved.

measurementUncertainty.ifCovarianceUnavailable: use a conservative bounded/interval propagation or separately report correlated calibration and pointwise components; do not invent root-sum-square independence

atmosphereInputRepresentation.aod550: external set-valued support interval derived without Pandora target radiance
atmosphereInputRepresentation.waterVaporAndOtherNonruntimeMeasurements: diagnostic only for current generation unless already represented by a frozen runtime axis

modelPredictionSet.forEachObservation: evaluate native plus each frozen aerosol scenario over the entire independently admitted AOD550 interval at the observation's frozen geometry

extremaRule.partition: all pairwise k-nearest distance-order crossings for both frozen Level-B residual IDW and ASIV IDW, plus exact-hit points
extremaRule.refinement: deterministic model-only interval branch-and-bound until every retained model log-range is enclosed to the frozen tolerance

centralScenarioSetMissLog.definition: minimum absolute log-distance from the measured central channel value to the frozen scenario-by-AOD model set

conservativeSetMissMag.reason: inherits the old central-error-plus-positive-uncertainty-allowance semantics rather than subtracting measurement uncertainty from the error budget

measurementIntervalIntersectsModelSet.definition: boolean overlap of a separately reported measurement uncertainty interval with the modeled set

signedScenarioSetMissLog.definition: zero inside the set; otherwise sign indicates model set above or below measured central log value, with tolerance-level sign ambiguity recorded as zero

forEachAdmittedChannel: worst preregistered marginal-stratum/channel P90 using session-first stratum means
measurement-interval overlap fraction as report-only diagnostic
native residual summaries as report-only diagnostics

uncertaintySeparation.asivInterpolationValidationError: computational validation descriptor retained as model error, not invented Gaussian measurement sigma
